title: AiCredentialPutV2
description: ai.credential-put@2 (OpenVibe.AI; Codes C3): one person's own provider key per provider, stored by the service that holds their consent, PUT /api/v1/credentials/{subject}/{provider} with capability ai.credential.manage. It adds the provider dimension to ai.credential-put@1: a person may keep an Anthropic, OpenAI, DeepSeek, MiniMax, OpenRouter or custom key side by side, each with its own daily budget, and the route without a provider still stores the default one. `key` is the secret (v1's `api_key` stays accepted); `base_url` names the endpoint of a custom provider and is optional elsewhere. OpenVibe.AI encrypts the key at rest, bound to its owner, subject and provider, and never returns it. Provider `node` is unchanged: the person's own machine, named by `machine`, with no key.

provider.description: anthropic = Anthropic's Messages API; openai = any OpenAI-compatible endpoint; deepseek, minimax and openrouter = those providers; custom = the endpoint in base_url (a URL that speaks the OpenAI or the Anthropic format, by the route it is used on); node = the person's own machine (no key, no base_url, no cost).

key.description: The provider key (ai.credential-put@2's name for v1's api_key). Required the first time, and whenever provider or base_url changes (a key is never sent to a new endpoint without being entered again); otherwise the stored key is kept, and it is never returned.

api_key.description: The ai.credential-put@1 name for `key`, still accepted. When both are sent, `key` wins.

base_url.description: The endpoint of a custom provider (required for it): https, no credentials, query or fragment. OpenVibe.AI connects only to public addresses.

machine.description: provider node: the person's own machine (openvibe.bot/machines) whose OpenVibe Node runs the model, or `any` of their own.

models.description: Model per role on this provider; `chat` is the default for the others.

budget_usd_per_day.description: The person's own daily cap on estimated spend with this provider's key; 0 or absent = no cap.
